title: Main Context Convergence Record
description: One tracked record of a single main context convergence performed by the authoritative main-synchronization sync point. Distinct from the refresh manifest, which records a durable operation and is deliberately kept untracked so a repeat refresh at the same revision produces no repository diff; this record is the git-native, reviewable claim that a convergence happened, pinning that manifest by content digest. Records are appended one per line to docs/merge-logs/context-convergence.jsonl and each line validates independently.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Incremented only on a breaking change.

operation_id.description: The ri-06 durable operation identity, derived from the repository id and the merged main revision. Two convergences that resolve the same id are the same convergence.

merged_revision.description: Main's HEAD after every merge in the pass, before the convergence commit. This is what the operation identity is keyed on.

refresh_revision.description: The revision the producers actually read. Equals merged_revision unless staged cleanup output was committed first, in which case it is that commit.

convergence_commit.description: The single follow-up commit this record landed in. Null only in a record emitted before the commit exists (an in-flight or aborted convergence).

manifest_path.description: Repository-relative path of the untracked ri-07 manifest. Null when the refresh failed before emitting one.

manifest_sha256.description: Content digest of the manifest at manifest_path. Pins an untracked file by content so the record remains verifiable in a fresh clone.

refresh_status.description: Terminal outcome of the refresh operation. 'not-run' records a convergence whose cleanup phase was committed but whose refresh never started (design D6, apparatus row).

producers.description: Per-producer outcome joined with its canonical owner. The join is required because the ri-06 ProducerResult carries no owner field; ownership lives on the registry ProducerSpec.

semantic_index.description: The enqueued index for the FINAL pushed revision. Deliberately a different revision from merged_revision: the convergence commit changes main's tip, and indexing the pre-convergence revision would immediately be stale.

status.description: Mirrors ri-06 SemanticIndexStatus. 'pending' is the expected value at convergence time: the request is enqueued, never awaited.

fallback.description: The bounded degradation guidance carried by every non-succeeded reference, e.g. exact search.

merged_pull_requests.description: The merges that produced this main state. Length >= 1 for any real convergence; a pass that merged nothing performs no convergence and emits no record.

change_id.description: OpenSpec change id when the PR was OpenSpec-driven and cleanup-feature --post-merge ran for it.

cleanup.description: Outcome of the cleanup-feature --post-merge phase for this PR.

warnings.description: Non-blocking degradations recorded during the pass: coordinator lock unavailable, optional owner absent, semantic service unreachable.
